newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Baer Q1 result higher, H1 seen higher.
newsitem.headline: Baer Q1 result higher, H1 seen higher.

text.p: The Julius Baer Group said business developed very well during the first quarter of 1997 and results were clearly above last year.

Based on the trend in the first four months, Rudolf Baer, president of the group management committee, also told the shareholders' meeting that he expected first half results to be "very good and significantly exceed the previous year".
The first half results will be released on August 8.

"The business of the Julius Baer Group developed very well overall in the first quarter of 1997, clearly surpassing the equivalent previous-year result," said a statement released after the shareholders' meeting of Julius Baer Holding AG.
Asset under management of the group rose to over 70 billion Swiss francs during the first quarter from 63.6 billion at the end of 1996.
This was reflected in commission income.
High volume in the securities markets also had a very positive influence on revenue.
Expenses for maintaining service quality increased relatively strongly, due to the growth of some activities, and the weak Swiss franc also had a negative effect.
